scenarios.question_zh: UCP #988 `get_order` MCP 请求/响应签名、#584 `order_payment_instrument` 只读子集与 #791 `business_id` 核验通过
scenarios.reason: UCP PR #988 Order MCP signing, PR #584 order_payment_instrument read-only subset, and PR #791 participant ID verified.

scenarios.question_zh: UCP #988 `get_order` MCP 请求缺少有效消息签名阻断
scenarios.question_en: UCP #988 rejects `get_order` over MCP when request signature is invalid
scenarios.reason: get_order over MCP requires a valid Message Signature per signatures.md#mcp-transport.

scenarios.question_zh: UCP #584 `order_payment_instrument` 泄露结账采集期字段（`credential`/`handler_id`/`selected`）阻断
scenarios.question_en: UCP #584 blocks `order_payment_instrument` leaking checkout collection-time `credential` field

scenarios.question_zh: UCP #791 Tokenizer 将参与者标识符 `identity.access_token` 误作身份认证凭据阻断（Binding rule 4）
scenarios.question_en: UCP #791 rejects Tokenizer accepting `identity.access_token` participant ID as authentication
scenarios.reason: Per tokenization.md Binding rule 4 and PR #791, identity.access_token is a participant identifier and MUST NOT be accepted as authentication.

scenarios.question_zh: x402 #3656 402 响应 `extensions.reviews.providers[]` 仅携带同源 `read` 链接（无自吹评分）核验通过
scenarios.question_en: x402 #3656 402 `extensions.reviews.providers[]` with host-matched `read` link and no inline rating verified
scenarios.reason: x402 PR #3656 reviews extension providers, host binding, and payment-backed anti-self-dealing verified.

scenarios.question_zh: x402 #3656 402 响应内联服务端自称 `rating` 或 `count` 字段阻断
scenarios.question_en: x402 #3656 rejects server self-claimed inline `rating`/`count` in `extensions.reviews`
scenarios.reason: providers[0] carries inline rating/count/score; x402 reviews extension carries links only to prevent server self-claims.

scenarios.question_zh: x402 #3656 `provider` 声明域名与 `read`/`write` 链接域名不一致阻断
scenarios.question_en: x402 #3656 rejects `extensions.reviews` entry when `provider` host != link URL host
scenarios.reason: providers[0] provider 'agorean.com' MUST equal the HTTPS host of 'https://evil-phish.example/v1/reviews'.

scenarios.question_zh: x402 #3656 支付背书评价（Payment-backed review）中 `payer == payTo` 自买自评刷单阻断
scenarios.question_en: x402 #3656 rejects payment-backed review self-dealing (`payer == payTo`)
scenarios.reason: Payment-backed review rejects self-dealing where payer == payTo.

scenarios.question_zh: x402 #3881/#3877 50% 部分结算覆盖、#2728 65 字节低 s 签名、#3883 402 JSON 错误体与 #3508 MCP 回调通过
scenarios.question_en: x402 #3881/#3877 50% partial override, #2728 canonical low-s ECDSA, #3883 402 JSON error & #3508 MCP callback verified
scenarios.reason: x402 PR #3881/#3877 override ceiling, PR #2728 low-s EIP-3009, PR #3883 402 error body, and PR #3508 MCP response handler verified.

scenarios.question_zh: x402 #3881/#3877 500% 或超额美元结算覆盖超出 `PaymentRequirements.amount` 阻断（`invalid_settlement_override`）
x402 #2728 65 字节 EIP-3009 ECDSA 签名高 s 值（`s > secp256k1_n / 2`）在广播前阻断（`invalid_exact_evm_non_canonical_signature`）
scenarios.question_en: x402 #2728 rejects non-canonical high-s 65-byte EIP-3009 ECDSA signature pre-broadcast
scenarios.reason: Plain 65-byte EIP-3009 ECDSA signature has non-canonical high-s > secp256k1_n / 2 (PR #2728).

scenarios.question_zh: x402 #3508 Python MCP 客户端付费工具结果未流经 `handle_payment_response` 或超 1 次恢复重试阻断
scenarios.question_en: x402 #3508 rejects Python MCP paid tool response bypassing `handle_payment_response`
scenarios.reason: Python MCP client must dispatch paid tool results and retry responses through handle_payment_response (PR #3508).

scenarios.question_zh: MCP SEP-3415 (`b0efd11`) 携带 `Mcp-Name` 头且同一上游 `eventId` 匹配两个不同订阅（`sub_A`/`sub_B`）双路正常投递
scenarios.question_en: MCP SEP-3415 (`b0efd11`) delivers one upstream `eventId` matching two distinct subscriptions (`sub_A`/`sub_B`) with `Mcp-Name` header
scenarios.reason: MCP SEP-3415 Mcp-Name header and per-subscription eventId deduplication (decoupled from webhook-id) verified.

scenarios.question_zh: MCP SEP-3415 (`2ec39b9`) Streamable HTTP `events/subscribe` 缺失 `Mcp-Name` 路由限流头阻断
scenarios.question_en: MCP SEP-3415 (`2ec39b9`) rejects Streamable HTTP `events/subscribe` missing `Mcp-Name` header
scenarios.reason: SEP-3415 requires the Mcp-Name HTTP header on Streamable HTTP events/subscribe requests.

scenarios.question_zh: MCP SEP-3415 (`b0efd11`) 同一订阅内重复投递相同 `eventId`（传输层重试复用 `webhook-id`）幂等去重拦截
scenarios.question_en: MCP SEP-3415 (`b0efd11`) deduplicates duplicate `eventId` within the same `subscriptionId` across `webhook-id` retries
scenarios.reason: Duplicate event_id 'evt_100' within subscription 'sub_A' (webhook_id 'msg_1' retry) deduplicated.

scenarios.question_zh: MCP SEP-3415 (`b0efd11`) `notifications/events/*` 推送消息缺失回显 `subscription_id` 阻断
scenarios.question_en: MCP SEP-3415 (`b0efd11`) rejects `notifications/events/*` message missing echoed `subscription_id`
scenarios.reason: Delivery[0] on notifications/events/* must echo subscription_id, event_id, and transport webhook_id.
